claim: If you use batching, non-high throughput FIFO queues support up to 3,000 messages per second, per API action; the 3,000 messages per second represent 300 API calls, each with a batch of 10 messages.

evidence.quote:
To enable high-throughput mode, see [Enabling high throughput for FIFO queues in Amazon SQS](enable-high-throughput-fifo.md).
+ If you use batching, non-high throughput FIFO queues support up to 3,000 messages per second, per API action (`SendMessage`, `ReceiveMessage`, and `DeleteMessage`). The 3,000 messages per second represent 300 API calls, each with a batch of 10 messages.
